network.field_types: documented strings or null; no unknown/label fields

process.records: logical CSV records, including quoted newlines
process.mapping: explicit timestamp_column and per-column analog/state definitions

profile.required: explicit synthetic profile; timestamp and column mappings

shared_task.shared_timestamps_accepted_here: fixture ISO8601 UTC Z only; no clock alignment
shared_task.missing_and_nonfinite: retained as null plus explicit quality reasons, never silently filled
shared_task.evidence: file SHA256 + logical record/column/raw time; resolved original records identical

packet_new_contract.network: strict bounded synthetic classic PCAP or single-interface PCAPNG
packet_new_contract.wire_scope: Ethernet IPv4 TCP 44818 / ENIP SendRRData / canonical CPF / CIP Get or Set Attribute Single canonical 8-bit logical path
packet_new_contract.acceptance_here: original capture re-decode + schema/hash/ranges + literal CIP path 200124013001 + all 3 request frame refs

input_limits.reference_paths: Submission references must be under shared-root inputs/ with matching SHA256; API generates immutable per-job snapshots; symlinks/escape rejected

isolated_defaults.runtime: Linux Docker compute image; finite package target Linux arm64
isolated_defaults.quota_meaning: upper admission/transfer bounds, not a guarantee every under-limit input completes

unsupported: real industrial validation or production deployment acceptance
live capture, automatic protocol identification, arbitrary adapters or unprofiled CSV
general TCP stack, IP fragmentation, VLAN, IPv6, sequence wrap, payload on unsupported control variants
ENIP/CIP commands or paths outside the named bounded subset
cross-source timestamp alignment, causal/attack/physical-success inference, detection scores or independent industrial labels
Windows native guardian/executor; architectures outside the finite package target
naive timestamps requiring unverified timezone databases as a shared cross-executor guarantee
resource limit exceedance as a successful or partially published task
arbitrary shell commands or user supplied compute plugins through the job payload
